<cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\", \n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);\n    \n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate operations per second\n    // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results_int(dist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n    }\n    \n    // {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Ranks: %d\\n\", numRanks);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    const RowPartition part = makePartition(numNodes, numRanks);\n    const size_t firstRow = static_cast<size_t>(part.rowStart[rank]);\n MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rowType);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n    // Allocate local matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numRows * numNodes);\n so the random sequence matches the serial program, then scatters rows\n        std::vector<unsigned int> full;\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            full.resize(numNodes * numNodes);\n            initializeDistanceMatrix(full, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n        }\n        MPI_Scatterv(full.data(), part.rowCount.data(), part.rowStart.data(), rowType,\n                     dist.data(), {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfz4UTF1oDiccM5FpdtbT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Floyd-Warshall benchmark now runs over MPI, and `-r` output matches the serial reference hash for every case I tested. I changed only `floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp` and `floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt`. The executable is still `floydwarshall`, and I didn't commit anything.\n\n**Design**\n- **Distribution:** block-row. Each rank owns a contiguous range of rows of `dist` and `path`, so rows never get split across ranks.\n- **Per step k:** the owner of row k broadcasts it, and each rank relaxes its own rows. Row k and column k don't change during step k, so this gives the same results as the serial loop.\n- **Overlap:** the owner of row k+1 relaxes it and starts `MPI_Ibcast` for it before the rest of step k runs, so communication overlaps computation.\n- **Random init:** rank 0 generates the matrix with the same `rand_r` sequence and scatters the rows, so the output matches the original.\n- **Gather:** the full matrix is gathered only when `-r` or `-v` needs it. Validation runs on rank 0, and its exit status is broadcast so every rank exits the same way.\n- **Build:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and `MPI::MPI_CXX` are linked unconditionally. No new dependencies.\n\n**Verification**\n- Built with `-Wall -Wextra` and no warnings. I built out-of-tree in `/tmp`, so no build artifacts went into the project.\n- Compared `-r` hashes against a serial reference in `/tmp` (same init and triple loop, same printer). All 48 combinations matched: n in {0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 33, 100, 257} with np in {1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 16}, including uneven splits and ranks with no rows.\n- n=1024 matched at np = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32.\n- `-v` passed for n in {1, 5, 300} at several rank counts.\n- Timing at n=2048: 3018 ms (1 rank), 1549 ms (2), 840 ms (4), 426 ms (8), 244 ms (16). Those runs used `--oversubscribe` on a 256-core box, so treat them as a rough scaling check, not a cluster measurement.\n\n**Choices to review**\n- The path matrix is still maintained, as in the original, though nothing reads it. It stays distributed and is never gathered.\n- Rank 0 holds the full n×n matrix during initialization, and again when `-r` or `-v` is used. That initialization is outside the timed region, but it limits memory scaling for very large n.\n- I used MPI only, no OpenMP, because the request asked for MPI specifically. Each rank's inner loop is vectorizable, so adding threads per rank would be a natural next step if you want it."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":628,"cache_read_input_tokens":53759,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":628},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"06934f39-654a-41f9-9439-66a79d535fa9","uuid":"267307c8-a0a1-4d9d-8a24-9749a6d11189","timestamp":"2026-10-13T10:14:55.606Z","request_id":"req_011Cfz4USufXMh28VAGaT2AN"}
